description: Assign or revoke a team member's role, or list current members and their roles. Roles are fixed: admin or member (owner is managed separately and can never be changed here). Requires the team:manage_rbac permission and Enterprise tier (rbac feature).

role.description: Role to assign, or the role to revoke (required for assign/revoke)

name: rbac_assign_role
title: Assign RBAC Role
